Updated version for leaving Early Access

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0.0
notes.content:
Updated version prepared for leaving Early Access

General:
- Player profiles for public and private matches are merged into one profile.
- Match is fully qualified if playing with other remote players (private or public).
- Some counters only incremented on fully qualified matches.
- Match is unqualified if playing only with harmless bots.
- Extra XP score not given in unqualified match. 
- Support for wide screen and fixed scaling depending on screen sizes
- Added character 3D view on players in the lobby and moved player-card view to the bottom
- Added character 3D view in match result podium
- Added second final kill-cam replay in third person with target zoom
- Support for path-finding/nav-mesh for NPC and improved NPC AI (possible to use old AI with Classic AI option)
- Lobbies now searched worldwide instead of Steam default

Gameplay:
- Added Shotgun weapon SpasDB
- Added Assault weapon TOMPA
- Added Machinegun weapon Serpent
- Added Assault weapon attachments
- Added Machinegun weapon attachments
- Added ice, fire and slime grenades
- Killcam icon option setting changeable during a match
- Updated and improved sound for weapons
- Silencer more distinct sound to differ from normal
- Adjusted hold breath not holding forever and not displaying help text after used
- Frag grenade countdown cross-air timer
- Bounce sound for grenade and axe
- Projectile sound for Noobtube bullet and axe

Sniper mode:
- Sniper mode allows the use of all primary weapons (converted to bolt action with reload set to 0.8 sec)
- Support for rotation left/right with keyboard bindings
- Added sniper mode option for private matches (increase wall bang and make bots not try to take the last score)

Infected:
- Added infected player pool for public matches
- Play music for the last player in infected game mode
- Removed powerups and XP-targets on night maps when playing infected
- Removed overlay lines for hunted players
- Default first player in infected is hunted (not zombie)
- Added NPC zombies in public infected matches on large maps
- Several more improvements for infected matches 

Customize:
- Added clothes and armor
- Added face skins
- Added more gear and skins
- Added berets prestige 01-10
- Move the character up/down in customization using the right mouse button 

Others:
- Improved Ambient Occlusion (Extra shadows) and selectable level (Off, Normal, High)
- Removed flickering while rotating in First-Person
- Added achievements for the number of  matches played
- Added missing translated texts to languages
- Added character high-score view for FFA, Team, and Infected.
- Added randomized bot outfit with gears
- Fixed Gnomed unlock
- Fixed Completionist unlock
- Fixed unlocks for M29 kills was counted from M26
- Fixed a long list of small problems and a few crashes
- Fixed host migration when the host lost from the network

Maps:
- Added two new night maps for infected
- Updated night maps for infected
- Updated mini maps for night maps
- Fixed missing collisions in Bunge
- Some minor fixes on several maps

False Front Team 2023-06-17

notes.title: False Front: Trailer & Beta signup
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/e798aeee903acbaebd5ded5f8b94d1403b1bc1d6.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p4mUgkiR-T8

[h1]Beta signups are now open!
[/h1]
To sign-up head over to our Discord server http://discord.falsefront.se and follow the instructions from there.

[h1]False Front![/h1]
False Front is a first-person shooter we at Svantech Studios have been working on for a little over 1.5 years, our vision with the project is to make a fps game that goes back to the old days of shooters yet still tries to innovate small but simple things to make the game stand out from the crowd!

Some of the things that we think are different from False Front compared to other fps games are:

[u][b]Security cameras: [/b][/u]The maps are packed with cameras that are shown on the jumbotron screens aswell as on the minimap if switched on. All players will be shown the same camera feed at the same time. This could work as a more complicated uav/radar and will hopefully spice up Search and Destroy games.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/0715b2192bbfb74f9fedb1df4b509b7a1c445d23.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Graphics/Enviroment:[/b][/u] The colorful graphics are not so common amongst first-person shooters and combined with the sporty theme we think we have created a nice and unique feel to the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/1eca15078e429ffce78b6c5ceefff787e8940528.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Powerups:[/b] [/u]There are various of power-ups located around the maps, these are Sprint, Insta-kill, Laser-aim and Extra-health. We designed these to be as fun for the player as possible while still not be annoying to other players. There are also a normal Health powerup which is the only way to regenerate health, hopefully these powerups will help control the player movement for the better.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/9d0c1ec7bba1863adf510faf8aada6ffa2af069f.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Free DLC’s:[/b] [/u]To compensate for the game not being FREE, we want to release all the future map DLC’s for FREE. This is also to make the DLC’s more fun for the community and not seen as something they have to pay hard earned money for. We instead plan to increase the price on the entire game after DLC releases, this will reward early buyers yet still give us some funding for the DLC’s.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/0824a322cd2857d85b919488a07eb739bf76a674.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/4f33a1061655d3032b2439513dc18ab41a877552.png[/img]

notes.title: False Front: Devlog 13
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/a587dedb1659fc11b3502d89e6e03335358ad7f4.jpg[/img]

[url=discord.falsefront.se] Join our discord here! [/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDJC_JjpvfA

[h1]Gameplay![/h1]
Above you can see 4 minutes of gameplay footage against bots using some new guns, note that some weapons might seem over powered and we are aware that they might needs some more balancing.

[h1]All weapons are done![/h1]
All weapons are now finished and in-game, we only need to fix and add some animations for all of the combat related things to be done. Below you can see all the new weapons we added since last devlog.

Tec-9 is the only dual wielding weapon so far in the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/03710faabf25730b4a6207b196677ff798e7a1be.jpg[/img]

The Noobtube is never fun to play against, but we’ve tried to add limits to it to make it less annoying.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/170b7ef27929c617fffe2e624e2812324ff696ce.jpg[/img]

KSG is the second shotgun and shoots less projectiles to make it more long range.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/3e7117c029ac6286836ffe1f98b0fa11fcdfd76c.jpg[/img]

AUG is the second assault rifle and is one of the two suppressed weapons in-game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/501266f93e06a206e5136693f55bc672e8006082.jpg[/img]

Have a great weekend!
/Svantech Studios

notes.title: False Front: Devlog 12
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/cb8e03deb0e3b1ffec3e3207cf3aafad74c42306.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/d8NTXr4] Join our discord here![/url]

This week we finally have some gameplay footage to show, although keep in mind this is early alpha footage and much are in subject to change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/1f644605ed6b6f65981ca15ff93165bc321292fa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Arena dome[/h1]
We have added a large blue dome to separate the gameplay area from the audience, hopefully this will bring some more context to the whole arena situation aswell as protect the audience from your evil bullets.

[h1]Gameplay footage![/h1]
Below you can see a short video showing some gameplay against bots. Hopefully you like it and don’t forget to subscribe to our youtube channel to see future videos.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cc4wEoN-OfA

[h1]Full weapon list![/h1]
We are finally done with all the weapons that will be included at launch. Two primary weapons per different class. Some of them are currently not working in-game though, but that should be fixed until the next devlog. We will now start to balance the guns as good as possible aswell as starting to make skins and camos for them but more on that in the next devlog. Below you can see pictures of all the weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/545d0a71267a8b6d77b82500138ad805fe627a4c.jpg[/img]

With the new weapons came also some changes to the customize screen, so here is a little video on how you will be able to customize your weapon classes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GoCuJHPtPNg

[h1]Audience[/h1]
As you might have noticed in earlier images we have now added an actual audience to our previously empty stadium. We know that it doesn’t look perfect at the moment but we won’t work more in it as for now, instead we will focus on more important things to do.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/987a20fd7e78a255c7d8f7f8dce1b379ec4afed7.jpg[/img]

Have a great day!
/Svantech Studios

notes.title: False Front - Devlog #11
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/167ff8f7f5e2911d799fc7766dcf7886b2f96fc7.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/d8NTXr4] Join out Discord server here! [/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/9854fee15e4001c73976eb9c95b4b91ad1dab95b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gameplay footage?[/h1]
We haven’t been able to show any real gameplay footage of the game yet. However, we are starting to feel quite happy with how the game looks and gameplay footage shouldn’t be that far away, although most things takes 5 times longer than expected, we will try to bring you some footage as soon as possible. To compensate for the lack of footage this devlog will contain mostly images of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/6d45f1fa25893fdc5d9e1dec84439f5a8d7fbc02.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/bc8d1d6097088c2a67feafea178341eec67fb7a8.jpg[/img]


[h1]Leveling/Progression system[/h1]
To give the game more playability we have added a progression and leveling system, much like other first-person shooters might have. However, we stayed away from “lootboxes” and went with a more traditional way of unlocking camos, weapons and other in-game items. We feel that we want the player to have control of what they feel like unlocking, not just unlocking things randomly from lootboxes, therefore you unlock things by completing specific challenges tied to that item.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/e31abbbbdf703637e3033fa8b01e419d8ede3fd2.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/5975f2400a0439bb375b2a16abe739fd635f0745.jpg[/img]

[h1]Online matchmaking[/h1]
Here are some images of what the online/private matchmaking screens will look like. (Note: The date 1st september is not a official date)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/5cdee73e4a27ca9c407dc6ad715c967daa1a0b9b.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/b3e91a68c0e4475bb21f29fbf907a8f03ef1876f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/899613024bda38ae7574430215bcdbb42abf3c47.jpg[/img]

notes.title: False Front - Devlog #10: New sniper!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/dd245b4a7b952e2340a6429037e3a33e5dbbc66b.jpg[/img]

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/false-front] Previous devlogs here![/url]

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/d8NTXr4] Join our discord here![/url]

[h1]Intervention[/h1]
There is no way we're launching a first-person shooter without an Intervention, so here we are. This is the second and last sniper we are making before launch, and we will now continue to make more ARs, SMGs and shotguns.  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/433b2babae9c7fee23ca4620b58164c21da16160.jpg[/img]

[h1]Arena maps[/h1]
1v1s is a big part of a first-person shooter, and we thought our current maps are rubbish for that. So we decided to make some smaller ones that are made for competing with your friends. These maps will not be in the online matchmaking rotation, so only for private matches, we currently only have one arena map but more will come in the future.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_ys5Hmzalo

notes.content:

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/false-front] Previous devlogs here![/url]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
We decided to update the old weapons, because they had a sort of “mobile game” vibe, which we don’t really want. So we increased the polygon count and texture count a bit to make them look more detailed. The image below shows the new and old assault rifle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32656946/3dd266ed7b3c71a011876a44f3a1f9f12757b294.png[/img]

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
We haven’t really got a lag problem at the moment, but we decided to work some on optimization. In the video above you can see out different shadow qualities none, bad, normal and good. We hope that this will make the game run smoother on low end computers and minimize lag.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hnhvOTirGoE
